title: The Five Elders' Conspiracy
next_chapter_hook: A cold glint flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes, his voice low like echoes from an abyss: "Chen Xuan left in haste back then, yet he had no idea how many things he shouldn't have taken with him. Next month's ritual, it's time for his son to taste that same flavor."

text.content: Night wind sliced like a blade, the ancient pines of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain casting grotesque shadows under the moonlight. Chen Ji held his breath, his entire body merged into the shadows of the rock face, not daring to move a single step. Thirty zhang ahead in the stone chamber, lamplight flickered as five elderly figures debated. Mo Xiansheng's question still lingered in his ears—why did his father insist on leaving the Tianqing Sect? This question was like a blunt knife, slowly cutting open the scar that had scarred his heart for years.

dialogue.content: "That waste has been making quite a stir lately." Ling Yuan sat upright at the main seat, fingers tapping lightly on the armrest, voice unhurried: "A servant disciple, yet he made the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius lose face publicly—if there were no ulterior reasons, would any of you believe it?"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank sharply. His layout at the Martial Arena that day had indeed been bold, yet he never expected it to draw the personal attention of the five elders. The candlelight in the stone chamber flickered intermittently, rendering those five silhouettes clear and blurry by turns, just like his murky and uncertain situation. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm grew slightly warm, as if warning him he stood amid some enormous danger.

dialogue.content: "Fifth Elder, what do you think?" Ling Yuan turned his head, gaze falling upon the gray-robed elder seated at the far end. The old man stroked his beard, but a flash of sharpness glinted in his murky eyes: "In this old man's view, this boy's actions are meticulous,滴水不漏—certainly no ordinary talent. Might as well act before his wings grow strong, and..." He made a throat-slitting gesture, his killing intent fully exposed without any restraint.

text.content: Chen Ji quietly retreated half a step, his back pressing against the cold rock wall. Five elders at the Golden Core stage—any one of them could crush him to dust. Let alone Ling Yuan, this Nascent Soul old monster—even a wisp of remnant soul was not something he could provoke at his current level. The dull pain in his chest reminded him that if exposed now, not only would revenge be impossible, but even survival would be a luxury.

dialogue.content: "We cannot act hastily." Ling Yuan raised his hand to halt the gray-robed elder's proposal, a meaningful smile curving his lips: "Since he dares to walk the martial world under the guise of a废物, he must have something to rely on. Acting rashly would only alert the prey." He paused, voice dropping several notches: "Why not use external forces—let him die silently."

text.content: External forces? Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly. The Tianqing Sect's five elders using outside forces to eliminate a servant disciple—this in itself was a monstrous joke. Unless... the one they intended to deal with wasn't some servant disciple at all, but someone else entirely. At this thought, his heart suddenly tightened, an ominous premonition coiling around his heart like a venomous snake.

dialogue.content: "Purge the sect." Ling Yuan slowly uttered these four words, each character seeming to be挤出 from between his teeth: "When Chen Xuan defected, he took the sect's supreme treasure. The Sect Master, considering old affection, did not pursue the matter. But that thing wandering outside is ever a hidden danger. Now his son has returned, making such a big stir..." The elders exchanged knowing glances: "If we do not purge the sect, how can we explain ourselves to our ancestors?"

text.content: Chen Xuan. Defection. Supreme treasure. These words exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder. The truth behind his father's disappearance twenty years ago actually involved the word "defection"? He had always believed his father died accidentally, never imagining such shocking secrets lay hidden behind it all. Fingernails deeply embedded in his palms, blood dripping between his fingers, yet he was oblivious to the pain.

dialogue.content: "Speaking of Chen Xuan..." Ling Yuan suddenly shifted topics, his tone gaining a murderous edge: "If he hadn't broken the rules back then, ruined our grand plan, that item would have fallen into our hands long ago. How laughable—a mere youngster dared to act like a mantis trying to stop a chariot, opposing us all!" The dragon head carved on the armrest cracked under his grip: "His son must pay the price for this!"

text.content: So that was it. Chen Ji finally understood. His father hadn't defected at all, but had no choice but to leave the Tianqing Sect to protect something, or someone. And the "item" the five elders spoke of was most likely the Tianji Record! They had coveted this treasure for years, even going so far as to turn against his father. Now that his father was gone, they pointed their spear at him. In his chest, a tidal wave of hatred surged like magma, nearly breaching the dam of his reason.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan suddenly raised his hand, silencing the elders' discussion. He tilted his head to listen for a moment, brow slightly furrowing: "Did any of you hear something?" Silence descended upon the stone chamber like death. Five wisps of divine sense spread outward like a tide. Chen Ji cursed internally, immediately urging the Tianji Record Fragment. An arcane power enveloped his entire being, transforming him into a barely perceptible breeze.

text.content: After a moment, Ling Yuan withdrew his divine sense, shaking his head: "Perhaps I'm overthinking it." The gray-robed elder冷笑 instead: "Eldest Brother, why be so careful? A mere Qi Refining waste—even if he had heaven-reaching abilities, could he possibly eavesdrop on our conversation?" As the words fell, laughter erupted in the stone chamber. Ling Yuan joined the laughter too, though that smile carried an indescribable chill.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record Fragment tightly, knuckles white. Rage burned like wildfire, nearly consuming his reason. But he knew clearly—if he acted rashly now, it would be like an egg colliding with a rock. He had to make a choice—endure silently and lay low, or strike directly and teach these old fools a bloody lesson?

choices.description: "A fire without fuel eventually dies out. Survive today, scheme for tomorrow. Exposing myself now would only result in being crushed to dust. Better to withdraw first, gather evidence, and settle accounts one by one when the time is ripe."

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his molars, forcing the raging fire in his chest back down. His father had taught him—if you cannot endure small matters, big plans will collapse. He took a deep breath, and using the Tianji Record as cover, retreated silently like a ghost. Behind him, the voices in the stone chamber gradually faded, yet those words branded themselves into his heart—defection, supreme treasure, purge the sect. These clues were enough for him to piece together the truth of twenty years ago.

choices.description: "If this can be endured, what cannot? They killed my father and dare act so arrogantly—today let them see what it means to play the pig to devour the tiger!"
choices.visible_cost: Expose one's strength, extremely high risk
choices.visible_reward: Humiliate the Five Elders publicly, reputation soars

choices.process_label: 陈机眼中杀意凛然，决定正面对抗

text.content: Chen Ji coldly smiled, stepping slowly out from the shadows. Why should they get to laugh and decide another's life and death? Why should they remain safe and sound while his father suffered injustice for twenty years? He was fed up with being toyed with like a piece on a chessboard. Since they wanted a废物, he would give them a spectacular surprise—let them know that when a废物 explodes, people can die too!

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan suddenly stood up, gaze fixed on the night sky beyond the window, voice low yet carrying undeniable authority: "Next month is the sect's ritual. When guests from all factions gather, that will be the perfect opportunity to act." He turned, scanning the assembled elders: "This time, we unite the Xuanwu Sect and Holy Sect's forces—must uproot this curse completely. The debt Chen's family owes us must be repaid."

text.content: United with the Xuanwu Sect and Holy Sect, three major powers joining forces against a servant disciple—this was the height of absurdity. But Chen Ji couldn't laugh. Because he knew only too well how deep these waters ran. The Xuanwu Sect had Han Lie, the genius he'd repeatedly crushed. The Holy Sect had countless connections to the forces behind Ye Qing. This move by the Five Elders was clearly借刀杀人—using others as a blade to kill, making him die without knowing why. What a brilliant scheme of借刀杀人, how vicious these five elders truly were!

choice.prompt: The lamplight in the stone chamber suddenly dimmed. Ling Yuan's voice rang out once more, carrying an eerie smile: "By the way, I almost forgot something." He leisurely drew a Jade Slip from his sleeve, gently setting it on the table: "Regarding Chen Xuan's affairs back then, this old man has some秘辛 that none of you know. If that boy truly has some ability, perhaps we should let him hear about his father's 'glorious achievements' back then..."

choices.description: Father's affairs far outweigh my own safety—even if only a ten percent risk of exposure, I must hear it.

In this moment, the answer seemed within reach.

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself to冷静下来. Greed leads to indigestion—tonight's harvest had already been startling enough. His father's "defection" had other hidden circumstances; the Five Elders had coveted the Tianji Record for years; next month's ritual was their time to act. This intelligence was priceless, enough to give him the initiative in the battles ahead. He silently retreated from the Back Mountain, disappearing into the vast night. Ling Yuan, wait—the debt, I will make you repay with interest!

dialogue.content: Just then, Ling Yuan suddenly narrowed his eyes, gazing into the darkness beyond the stone chamber. His divine sense was like an invisible blade, silently piercing through the night sky. After a moment, he withdrew his divine sense, a playful smile curling his lips: "Interesting... from the Back Mountain direction, there seems to be a faint, ethereal fluctuation." The gray-robed elder's face changed: "Eldest Brother means..." Ling Yuan waved his hand, smile growing increasingly sinister: "No need to panic. Just a mouse that came to eavesdrop."

text.content: The air in the stone chamber seemed to凝固. All five elders' gazes shot toward the window, killing intent fully exposed. Chen Ji felt a bone-piercing chill crawl from his tailbone to the crown of his head, nearly freezing him solid. A Nascent Soul old monster's divine sense—he had been careless! At this critical moment, the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm suddenly burned hot. An indescribable power swept him up entirely, transforming him into a wisp of smoke disappearing into the night. When Ling Yuan's divine sense swept across that rock face, only an empty darkness remained.

A cold glint flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes, his voice low like echoes from an abyss: "Chen Xuan left in haste back then, yet he had no idea how many things he shouldn't have taken with him. Next month's ritual, it's time for his son to taste that same flavor."
